correctness.rationale: Stationary OU covariance follows exactly from the Lyapunov equation; the binary Yule ordered-pair decomposition yields the normalized clonal covariance integral with the correct branching-growth and factor-of-two normalization. Three derivatives yield the exact commutator identity; eigenbasis inversion proves if-and-only-if global injectivity; the closest-gap pair proves optimal inverse constant; commuting repeated-eigenspace rotation gives all-time identical readout with positive EPR. An independent rational Taylor checker passes 287 finite tests but is not substituted for the proof. Stationary covariance whitening gives an exact equivalence to all nondegenerate stationary OU diffusions and does not alter the derived inverse criterion.

originality.rationale: The forward branching covariance Eq. (19) of Michoel is prior and openly credited. The inspected original text (including its 2D nonequilibrium examples) does not formulate the complete if-and-only-if rotational identifiability boundary, minimal jet order, sharp spectral-gap inverse bound and irreversible all-age blind family. value.rationale: The complete spectral observation criterion exposes precisely when bulk clonal fluctuation measurements can infer hidden steady probability currents and when even all-time data is blind to irreversible flow. The minimal informative derivative and sharp conditioning near the spectral collision are natural quantitative consequences with experimental identifiability relevance, and the all-dimensional if-and-only-if result is substantially more than a narrow numerical special case. The result is invariant under stationary covariance whitening and thus addresses general nondegenerate multivariate OU systems, not an artificially tuned diffusion class.
